record.original_question: Is the class of lattices that are isomorphic to a sublattice of the lattice of subgroups of some Abelian group a variety?

evidence.quote: [J´ ons1953, sec. 5] Is the class of lattices that are isomorphic to a sublattice of the lattice of subgroups of some Abelian group a variety?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an Abelian group $A$, let $\mathrm{Sub}(A)$ denote the lattice of all subgroups of $A$, ordered by inclusion (with meet given by intersection and join by the subgroup generated by the union). Let $\mathcal{C}$ be the class of all lattices $L$ such that there exists an Abelian group $A$ with $L$ isomorphic to a sublattice of $\mathrm{Sub}(A)$. A variety of lattices is a class of lattices closed under homomorphic images, sublattices, and arbitrary direct products (equivalently, definable by a set of lattice identities). 

Determine whether $\mathcal{C}$ is a variety of lattices.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a classical problem attributed to Jónsson (1953). Web searches surface related work on subgroup lattices of finite abelian groups (Baer, Inaba, Jónsson–Monk) and surveys on group varieties versus normal-subgroup lattices, but no source clearly resolves whether the class of lattices embeddable into subgroup lattices of abelian groups forms a variety. Status could not be conclusively verified.

status_evidence.title: Varieties of groups and normal-subgroup lattices—a survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on Jónsson-type problems relating group varieties and lattices of (normal) subgroups.
status_evidence.claim: Discusses Jónsson's program on varieties and subgroup lattices but does not state a resolution of this specific embedding question.

status_evidence.title: A characterization of subgroup lattices of finite Abelian groups
status_evidence.snippet: Lattices of subgroups of finite abelian p-groups were characterized by Baer, Inaba, and Jónsson–Monk.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterizations exist, but the variety question for sublattices of abelian subgroup lattices is not settled here.
